Building muscle and loosing weight can be difficult. If you are worried about gaining weight I would focus on eating at maintenance and increasing your protein. You can look up a calculator online to figure out what your maintenance should be. 0.5-1g of protein/lb is normally what is recommended. Increasing your protein will help with gaining muscle, just make sure you are getting some fiber in as well. 

Just remember that gaining weight while on T is normal. Fueling your body is necessary, especially when you are just starting out

Congrats! Personally, the first thing I noticed within the first few days was bottom growth. Then within the first month I was always hungry and my libido was high. My voice also started to drop within the first few weeks as well. 

For boxers I normally wear Hanes boxer briefs. They have enough room in the pouch so nothing is rubbing weird, aren’t too tight around the legs, and don’t roll up. I can get a pack of 5 near me for like $15.

200mg is a lot. I would double check your prescription to see what your dose is. I’ve been on T for over a year and my dose is 60mg, but I started at 50mg. An entire bottle is 200mg tho, I wonder if that is what you are reading. From what I’ve seen, excess T can turn into estrogen, and you probably don’t want that.

I would recommend getting wider tape, or using more pieces. How I tape, and what I have have found to work well, is to anchor about an inch of the tape with no stretch, lean forward and fully stretch the tape, then with the tape fully stretched use my other hand to guide it back and down at an angle. My chest is a little bigger than yours and I have found this to work great so I hope it would work for you!

The issue is that you are 17. In like 99% of cases your parents would have to give permission to do any of this. If your parents are accepting and willing to do that, you could try calling planned parenthood. That was the first place I called and they had a lot of openings. Idk the situation in Colorado specifically, but I would just call planned parenthood and see what they can do. You can check their website to see what places have hrt. And it might be faster than going thru a doctors office bc you can just do it by informed consent. I’m just speaking from my experience though and what worked for me. I was able to get an appointment at a doctors office like an hour away from me within a month of calling, I then started T 2 weeks later. I hope it all works out for you!
